'''Tatrang VIII''' was an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] in the eighth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position of the [[Tatrang system]],<ref name="PoG2" /> located in the [[Tammuz sector/Legends|Tammuz sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="TEA-OC" />
